_comment: DESIGN.md v2 §14. scripts/budget_check.py compares results/timing/<stage>.json against these timeboxes and lists any Tier B/C stage started before all Tier A stages were done. Anything unfinished is reported 'not done: time'.

milestones.content: DESIGN v2, round-2 review, freeze-design (sim bounds, pc_eligibility, frozen hashes)
dictionary, screen covariates, eligibility, controls csv, cgt features, guard/gate extensions, data_status (start of M4 deadline), toy simulation (separate agent, parallel)
4 arms + MD-strict, confounder audit, gate attempt 1, null (background), replication dry run
subtypes per gene and per module, cross-lineage, co-location, cutting, culture, hypermutation; Tier B attribution in background
CGT build + freeze-cgt (may start in M3b), ceiling, Q4a-d, combinatorial lookup
independent reimplementation check, freeze-catalogue, replication in R (once), XLIB
limits classes, claims table, REPORT.md, report-number check, review

B.rule: after all Tier A stages of the current milestone are done
B.attribution_rules: M1-proxy from saved t_E_status folds (exact linear); M3 refit for panel genes with pred_contrib; per-gene reproduction r >= 0.999 else report shortfall and continue; one diagnosis attempt <= 30 min

cut_order_if_M4_ends_gt_1h_late: direct_attribution_panel (AC5 component readout is the pre-declared fallback)
concurrency: never run the Tier B refit (4-6 processes, ~3.3 GB) concurrently with a 12-worker job
